project.name: TerraGlyph Engine for ScummVM
project.tagline: The Learning Company's Scooby-Doo CD-ROM adventures, playable again through ScummVM

focus.label: Current work
focus.headline: Google TV app pipeline (WP-085): library, game import, test packages and updates
focus.doneWhen: On the TV: the app installs with its own identity, imports a legally obtained game, installs a hash-verified test package, and keeps games and saves through updates.

milestones.title: Format research
milestones.doneWhen: A game image decodes, the art archive is documented, the audio codec is named, and the engine-family question is answered.

milestones.title: ScummVM engine scaffold and game detection
milestones.doneWhen: The engine builds against the pinned ScummVM and recognises the four in-scope discs.

milestones.title: Showdown in Ghost Town: every game class ported
Phantom of the Knight: every game class ported
Showdown closeout and release readiness
milestones.doneWhen: A full playthrough reaches the credits and save and load work.

milestones.title: Phantom closeout and release readiness (WP-087)
milestones.doneWhen: A full playthrough reaches the credits, save and load work, and Phantom is declared ADGF_TESTING.

milestones.title: Google TV app pipeline (WP-085)
milestones.doneWhen: All four milestones are verified on the TV, and the app downloads no executable code.
milestones.note: Pre-flight ready and claimed 2026-11-26; built first (decided 2026-11-26).

milestones.title: D-pad with fine cursor movement
milestones.doneWhen: With only the TV remote, the pointer moves finely enough to click a button or object.
milestones.note: Related: WP-086 (drafted 2026-11-26) researches D-pad jumps between hotspots, a different route to the same TV-remote gap.

milestones.title: Google Play developer account and beta testing
milestones.doneWhen: A test build installs on the TV from a Google Play testing track.
milestones.note: How long it takes depends on WP-084's D3, the account type: a personal account created after 2023-11-13 must run a closed test with 12 testers for 14 consecutive days before production; an organization account (D-U-N-S) skips that.

milestones.title: Free Google Play release (WP-084)
milestones.note: Waits on WP-085 and on Gate 0 for the bundled freeware game.

milestones.title: Jinx at the Sphinx (generation 2)
milestones.doneWhen: The second-generation archive container is read and the game plays.

parkingLot.item: Shared runtime with separate game-data apps
parkingLot.why: An architecture investigation; it would build on the TV app.
It runs the second-generation engine; its mini-games join a tier only by decision.
Held at the fork (decided 2026-11-21); declined for now, not foreclosed.

vision.tagline: Owning an old game shouldn't require owning an old computer.
vision.intro: A ScummVM engine that reads the original game data directly, so players can use their own discs on hardware they own today.

items.text: Bundling or redistributing copyrighted game data. Players supply their own discs.
Modding, rebalancing or changing the games. The goal is faithful playback.
Supporting platforms ScummVM doesn't already support.
